text: Today, we release d1-ultra, our new multimodal decision model with state-of-the-art performance . Most decision models work well on easy and common tasks. We built d1-ultra for harder, messier real-world use cases, like spotting a defect on a circuit board against its spec or checking a damage claim against the customer’s photo. d1-ultra is available today on the Liquid API at $0.042 per million input tokens. d1-ultra answers the same three question types as d1: Compared to d1, we based d1-ultra on a larger open-weight model with a series of Liquid-specific heavy customizations. It provides significant gains when combined with our training pipeline, especially on knowledge-related tasks. We compared it to our previous model d1 and Jev 1.14 across 112 unique evaluations. Accuracy is not enough: decision models also output probabilities that must be properly calibrated. We realized that most decision models are overconfident in their responses. That’s why we specifically trained d1-ultra to produce more reliable probabilities. d1-ultra outperforms Jev 1.14 across all tasks, delivering better-calibrated answers and higher accuracy at the same price. To see how it works in practice, you can find more demos running on d1-ultra in the d1 Playground . d1-ultra also outperforms all other decision models Artificial Analysis Decision Index by at least 8 points." d1-ultra is available on the Liquid AI API . Create your API key and start building today. d1-ultra will soon be available through Vercel and OpenRouter . The model reads text, images, or both at the same time, like in this example: import base64, os, requests image = base64.b64encode(open("board.jpg", "rb").read()).decode() response = requests.post( "https://api.liquid.ai/decisions/v1/systemone", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['LIQUID_API_KEY']}"}, json={ "model": "d1-ultra", "images": [f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image}"], "state": "Camera image of a circuit board on the production line.", "questions": {"defect": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Does this circuit board have a defect?" } }, }, ) print(response.json()["answers"]["defect"]["noul"]) The full API reference is in the decision models documentation . d1-ultra is billed on input tokens only, with no output tokens. Images are counted as input tokens at the same rate as text: 1.5 tokens per 32×32-pixel patch, so a 1024×1024 image costs 1,536 tokens. Each question is billed as its own prompt, including its text and all images. d1-ultra is our most capable decision model so far. We’re committed to continuing our work on decision models across a range of sizes, with new features, higher decision quality, and lower latency, and we plan to provide regular updates.
